title: Computed Columns
description: Learn how to use computed columns to derive values from other columns in SQL Server.

data.text: Computed columns are columns whose values are derived from an expression using other columns in the same table. They allow you to reuse calculation logic without repeating it in every query.
Use ALTER TABLE ADD with an expression to create a computed column:

data.title: Add Computed Column
data.content: Adds a full_name computed column to the persons table.
data.code:
ALTER TABLE persons
ADD full_name AS (first_name + ' ' + last_name);

data.text: Now queries can reference full_name directly instead of repeating the CONCAT expression:

data.title: Query Using Computed Column
data.content: Queries the persons table using the computed full_name column.
data.code:
SELECT 
    person_id, 
    full_name, 
    dob
FROM 
    persons
ORDER BY 
    full_name;

data.alt: SQL Server Computed Column example output showing full_name column

data.text: Computed columns can be persisted, meaning SQL Server physically stores the computed values on disk. This avoids calculation overhead at query time at the cost of extra storage.

data.title: Add Persisted Computed Column
data.content: Adds a persisted computed column for full_name.
data.code:
ALTER TABLE persons
ADD full_name AS (first_name + ' ' + last_name) PERSISTED;

data.title: Note
data.text: A computed column can only be persisted if its expression is deterministic. Non-deterministic functions like GETDATE() cannot be persisted.

data.title: Computed Column Syntax
data.content: Syntax for adding a computed column to an existing table.
data.code:
ALTER TABLE table_name
ADD column_name AS expression [PERSISTED];

data.title: Computed Column in CREATE TABLE
data.content: Syntax for defining a computed column when creating a new table.

data.title: Computed Columns Key Points
points: Computed columns derive their values from expressions on other columns.
Use PERSISTED to physically store computed values on disk.
Persisted computed columns can have indexes created on them.
Only deterministic expressions can be persisted.
Computed columns simplify queries by eliminating repeated expressions.
